summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Ero Copper Corp., a Canadian foreign private issuer, furnishing materials for its annual general and special meeting of shareholders to be held June 29, 2026. The agenda includes standard items: receiving audited financial statements, re-electing ten directors, reappointing KPMG as auditor, approving stock option and share unit plans, and a non-binding advisory vote on executive compensation. No extraordinary event—merger, acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, or activist campaign—is disclosed. The filing is a typical proxy circular and meeting notice, not a special situation.
